title: Supply, Testing and Commissioning of High-Pressure Motor Operated Valves (MOV) & Hydraulic Actuators Package
organization: GAIL (India) Limited (Gandhar LPG Plant / Western Region)

clauses.heading: Legal Status and Statutory Registration
clauses.raw_text: The bidder must be a company registered under the Companies Act, 2013 or a registered LLP. The entity must possess an active GSTIN, valid corporate PAN, and must not be debarred by GeM or any Central PSU.

requirements.title: Active GSTIN & Corporate Registration
requirements.description: Bidder must possess active and un-suspended GSTIN registration matching the legal entity name.

clauses.heading: Financial Pre-Qualification & Annual Turnover Criteria
clauses.raw_text: The minimum average annual turnover of the bidder during the last three financial years (FY 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25) must be at least ₹8.55 Crores (30% of tender value per Rule 144(xi) GFR 2017). Bidders must submit audited balance sheets signed by a Chartered Accountant with valid 18-digit UDIN.

requirements.title: Minimum Annual Turnover Threshold
requirements.description: Average annual turnover must equal or exceed ₹8.55 Crores.
requirements.required_evidence_type: Audited Balance Sheets & CA UDIN Certificate

clauses.heading: Technical Specification & Hydrostatic Pressure Benchmark
clauses.raw_text: All supplied equipment must strictly conform to API Spec 6A / 6DSS / ASME B16.34 standards with hydrostatic shell test holding duration of continuous 120 minutes with zero observable leakage or pressure drop exceeding 0.02 bar/min.

requirements.title: Hydrostatic Pressure Test Compliance
requirements.description: Hydrostatic shell test with zero leakage under rated pressure for 120 minutes.
requirements.required_evidence_type: OEM Quality Inspection & Factory Hydrostatic Test Certificate

clauses.heading: Make in India (PPO-MII) Local Content Preference
clauses.raw_text: Purchase preference shall be granted to Class-I Local Suppliers (local content >= 50%) under DPIIT Order P-45021/2/2017-PP (BE-II). Suppliers with local content >= 20% but < 50% are categorized as Class-II Local Suppliers.

requirements.title: DPIIT Class-I Local Content Verification
requirements.description: Audited Bill of Materials demonstrating domestic value addition >= 50%.
requirements.required_evidence_type: Statutory Auditor Local Content Certificate & Customs Deconstruction
